rawContent: I have supported all things ie; #MeToo #BlackLivesMatter  #WomensMarch etc(just as examples)  only to see several get completely out of control. I won’t jump unless there are legit receipts and vids are vetted to make sure they aren’t staged. I know racists are showing out ..

but some of these vids are obvious setups  and whatever happened to Bourdain’s girlfriend who was one of the faces of #MeToo then a kid who was underage brought receipts , was paid off, AB is dead she has disappeared ...I will use my judgement , not be so quick to just accept .

@Bruce35dc @truthrightmeow @rosemcgowan @JoeBiden @DNC Who cares if she votes? Or who she votes for . I’ve been raped..and groped ...but I refuse to paint myself as a victim .
